notes.title: M.I.N.D. Has a Steam page now!
notes.content:
Hi!

I'm Kasper, the lead developer of M.I.N.D. and as you can see, we finally got our game here for everyone to look at!

The scheduled release date is in early April now, so you won't have to wait long anymore! 

If you have any questions, you can ask us on twitter @CosmoticGames or email us at cosmoticgames@gmail.com

Thank you for reading and stay tuned for more!
